RESULT [weeds]: COCO-initialised mAP50-95: YOLOv8n 0.679 -> 0.720, YOLOv9t 0.666 -> 0.724, YOLOv10-N 0.603 -> 0.676. From-scratch training gains were larger, up to +30% mAP50 for YOLOv10-N.
US [weeds]: The pipeline matches ours (generate, then auto-label with the current best detector), and the gains land mostly on small edge models, which is what the robot runs. The best ratio differed per model, which argues for the loop to try synthetic data in measured increments with rollback, not in one bulk merge.
CORRECTION [weeds]: Confirmed: about 5,200 synthetic images from a real set of 2,074 sugar-beet images; YOLOv8x auto-labelling; ratios of 10-200%; COCO-initialised mAP50-95 for YOLOv8n 0.679->0.720, YOLOv9t 0.666->0.724, YOLOv10-N 0.603->0.676; from scratch, YOLOv10-N gained up to +30% mAP50 (at 190% synthetic).
